questions.q: How is Kara related to Superman in the comics?
questions.why: Kara is Superman's cousin, the daughter of Zor-El and Alura.

questions.q: Which actress starred in the TV series Supergirl that premiered in 2015?
questions.why: Melissa Benoist played Kara Danvers in the series.

questions.q: Who played Supergirl in the 1984 Supergirl film?
questions.why: Helen Slater starred in the film, the first live-action Supergirl.

questions.q: What was the name of the domed settlement that drifted through space after Krypton exploded, where Kara grew up?
questions.why: Argo City drifted through space under a dome after Krypton exploded, until Kara was sent to Earth.

questions.q: What are the names of Kara's parents?
questions.why: Her parents are Zor-El and Alura.

questions.q: In which year did Kara first appear in Action Comics #252?
On which network did the TV series Supergirl premiere before moving to The CW?
questions.why: The show launched on CBS in October 2015, then moved to The CW in 2016.

questions.q: Which two creators introduced Kara to comics?
questions.why: Otto Binder and Al Plastino created her.

questions.q: Which actress played Kara in the 2023 film The Flash?
questions.why: Sasha Calle played the character in the 2023 film.

questions.q: Which writer's 1996 Supergirl series merged the Matrix with a human named Linda Danvers?
questions.why: Peter David and Gary Frank created the Linda Danvers version.
